verseText: I can do all things through Christ who gives me strength.
meaning: Paul wrote these words. He experienced both good times and bad. But he trusted Christ Jesus to give him strength to face every situation and do what God called him to do.

meaning.question: What kind of strength is this verse about?
choices: Strength to face what God calls us to
A promise that life will be easy

application.prompt: When something God wants you to do feels hard, ask Christ to give you strength to do it faithfully.
